scenarios.name: Baseline Operational Plan
scenarios.description: Standard steady-state plan using baseline forecast and historical supplier lead times.

scenarios.name: Promotional Expansion (+15% Demand)
scenarios.description: Commercial trade promotion featuring temporary price reductions and in-store endcap displays.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Demand shift of +15.0% creates a 10,501,534 unit (increase) in 13-week forecast. Replenishment orders increase by +271,903 units (+29.2%). ⚠️ 109 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Aggressive Seasonal Surge (+30% Demand)
scenarios.description: Holiday or multi-buy volume spike across high-velocity FMCG categories.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Demand shift of +30.0% creates a 21,003,067 unit (increase) in 13-week forecast. Replenishment orders increase by +554,420 units (+59.5%). ⚠️ 266 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Minor Port / Customs Delay (+3 Days Lead Time)
scenarios.description: Cross-border logistics friction extending supplier delivery cycles by 3 calendar days.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Supplier lead-time elongation of +3 days alters replenishment horizon. Replenishment orders increase by +1,362,162 units (+146.1%). ⚠️ 399 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Severe Supply Bottleneck (+7 Days Lead Time)
scenarios.description: Major regional transport interruption adding a full 7 days to vendor fulfillment cycles.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Supplier lead-time elongation of +7 days alters replenishment horizon. Replenishment orders increase by +3,847,150 units (+412.6%). ⚠️ 688 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Critical Logistical Disruption (+14 Days Lead Time)
scenarios.description: Prolonged port strike or severe natural disruption extending lead times by 2 full weeks.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Supplier lead-time elongation of +14 days alters replenishment horizon. Replenishment orders increase by +9,064,974 units (+972.3%). ⚠️ 926 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Stock Shrinkage & Spoilage (-25% Inventory)
scenarios.description: Perishable item spoilage, cold-chain failure, or warehouse inventory variance loss.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Stock adjustment of -25.0% reduces available inventory by 1,434,098 units. Replenishment orders increase by +438,812 units (+47.1%). ⚠️ 292 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.

scenarios.name: Compound Bullwhip Shock (+20% Demand, -20% Stock, +7d Delay)
scenarios.description: Worst-case concurrent stress: demand acceleration colliding with stock depletion and vendor delay.
scenarios.summary_highlight: Demand shift of +20.0% creates a 14,002,045 unit (increase) in 13-week forecast. Stock adjustment of -20.0% reduces available inventory by 1,147,278 units. Supplier lead-time elongation of +7 days alters replenishment horizon. Replenishment orders increase by +6,585,626 units (+706.4%). ⚠️ 973 additional items escalate to HIGH stockout risk.
